title: The Emberwyrm of Justin's Forge
description: Justin's original fire-serpent: a forge-dwelling wyrm that eats waste heat and breathes clean steam.

title: The Codex Moth
description: Justin's original lore-keeper: a giant moth whose wings carry the index of every book ever written in his world.

title: The Gear-Turtle
description: Justin's original world-bearer: a tortoise whose shell turns like clockwork, carrying a city on its back.

title: The Lantern Fox
description: Justin's original guide-spirit: a fox whose tail-tip burns with a cold blue flame that lights true paths.

title: The Tide-Singer Whale
description: Justin's original sea-being: a whale whose song tunes the tides, heard by sailors before storms.

title: The Clockwork Crow
description: Justin's original messenger: a crow of brass and feather that carries messages that must arrive on time.

title: The Root-King Stag
description: Justin's original forest sovereign: a stag whose antlers grow into the trees it protects.

title: The Star-Chart Serpent
description: Justin's original sky-being: a serpent of constellation-light that redraws the sky for navigators.
